hooks.prompt: Review this Svelte/TypeScript code change for domain-specific issues. File: $ARGUMENTS. Check for: 1) Legacy Svelte 4 patterns (writable/readable stores, $: reactive declarations, on:event instead of onevent) — these MUST use Svelte 5 runes ($state, $derived, $effect, $props, onclick). 2) Missing TypeScript strict compliance (any types, missing return types on exported functions). 3) Accessibility violations (missing aria attributes on interactive elements, click handlers without keyboard equivalents). 4) Performance concerns (unnecessary $effect when $derived would work, missing lazy loading for heavy components). Respond {"ok": true} or {"ok": false, "reason": "specific violation with line reference and fix suggestion"}.

Evaluate whether this development session is complete. Context: $ARGUMENTS. Check: 1) Were all requested features/fixes implemented? 2) Are there TODO comments or placeholder implementations left behind? 3) Were TypeScript types properly defined (no 'any' types)? 4) Were accessibility attributes added to interactive elements? 5) Was performance considered (lazy loading, code splitting for new routes)? 6) Are there any console.log statements that should be removed? Respond {"ok": true} if work appears complete, or {"ok": false, "reason": "specific incomplete items"}.
